comparison.objective: Candidate breaks and retrieves insert tangs; record hangs a telescoping rack rail between two posts and latches it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial micro-tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and small-fragment pickup; record requires supporting a rail, peg insertion, telescopic extension, and latch engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures and contained fragments without hardware displacement; record requires front and rear pegs seated, rail latched, released, and arms returned. No specs are present.
comparison.reason: Telescoping rail installation tests sustained support, extension, and latching rather than sacrificial-feature fracture and recovery.
